text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean absolute error of the median forecast, in points of the substation's capacity (smaller is better), by how many days ahead the forecast is. N1 is an XGBoost quantile model trained on the ENS control member from April 2024, with lagged power measured from the forecast origin. S1 is an XGBoost model trained on ERA5 weather from September 2023, without lagged power. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds.'
text.tspan: Mean absolute error of the median forecast, in points of the substation's capacity (smaller
is better), by how many days ahead the forecast is.
N1 is an XGBoost quantile model trained on the ENS control member from April 2024, with
lagged power measured from the forecast origin. S1 is an XGBoost model trained on ERA5
weather from September 2023, without lagged power.
16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds.
